text: The purpose of this report is to reconcile an inconsistency between Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolutions with respect to the authority of the President and certain Management to award a contract through a non-competitive procurement process or limited solicitation. Under Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 5-7: Procurement, the President and certain Management are provided the authority to award a contract through a non-competitive procurement process or limited solicitation. These same authorities are not reflected in Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 5-10: Delegation of Authority. To reconcile this inconsistency, Management is recommending that Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 5-10: Delegation of Authority be amended to recognize the authorities under Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 5-7 for the President and Vice Presidents to award a…

The Toronto Parking Authority - Audit and Risk Management Committee recommends that: 1. The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority approve the proposed amendments to Toronto Parking Authority Policy Resolution 5-10: Delegation of Authority as outlined in Appendix B to the report (June 11, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority and direct the President, Toronto Parking Authority, to enact Policy Resolution 5-10: Delegation of Authority, as amended.
